description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing TsKvEntity objects in a SQL database, including custom queries for statistical operations and data retrieval based on entity ID, key, and timestamp range.

classes.name: TsKvRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for TsKvEntity with custom query methods for data retrieval and manipulation.

methods.name: findAllWithLimit
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TsKvEntity objects within a specified time range and entity, with pagination support, using a native SQL query.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes TsKvEntity records for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findStringMax
methods.description: Finds the maximum string value and its timestamp for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findNumericMax
methods.description: Calculates maximum numeric values (long and double) and their counts for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findStringMin
methods.description: Finds the minimum string value and its timestamp for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findNumericMin
methods.description: Calculates minimum numeric values (long and double) and their counts for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findCount
methods.description: Counts non-null boolean, string, long, and double values for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findAvg
methods.description: Calculates the sum and count of numeric values for averaging purposes for a specific entity, key, and time range.

methods.name: findSum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of numeric values for a specific entity, key, and time range.
